description: List the seller's Amazon shipping templates on ONE store — each template's id (the value Amazon takes) and name (as typed in Seller Central), read from Amazon's seller-specific product type schema through any category mapped to a product type. Templates exist per store (amazon.de has its own). When Amazon names none for this seller, templates is empty and note says so: templates are created in Seller Central only (no API creates or edits them), and until one is assigned Amazon applies the account's default shipping settings. Needs a category mapped to an Amazon product type (update_category) and a listing marketplace on the Amazon connection; no arming. Read-only: it changes nothing. Then assign one with set_amazon_shipping; use get_amazon_fields for the other product type fields.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store. Templates exist per store.

name: list_amazon_shipping_templates
title: List Amazon shipping templates
